chains.title: CEBPA binds the alt T allele at a SORT1 enhancer and increases SORT1, lowering LDL risk

links.claim: The alt T allele strengthens the C/EBP bZIP binding specificity in QBiC-SELEX group G035, where CEBPA is an own-model passing member with alt-more direction (z 22.63); CEBPA also has an ENCODE ChIP-seq peak containing rs12740374 in HepG2. This supports CEBPA occupancy but does not by itself prove allele-specific binding.
rs12740374 lies within EH38E1374646, a distal enhancer-like cCRE with DNase, H3K27ac and H3K4me3 signal, making it a plausible allele-sensitive regulatory element.
SORT1 is the top L2G gene for the credible sets and has a liver sQTL; the alt T allele also increases liver SORT1 expression in GTEx, making SORT1 the leading candidate target.
Hep3B is the stated expression context, CEBPA is highly expressed there, and CEBPA ChIP-seq occupancy is seen in HepG2, supporting a hepatocyte CEBPA-dependent mechanism.

The G allele is the high-cholesterol risk allele, while the alt T allele increases liver SORT1 expression; this is consistent with the T allele being LDL-lowering/protective at the 1p13 locus, though GWAS effect sizes do not fully resolve LDL direction.

predictions: CEBPA occupancy at rs12740374 is stronger on the T allele than on the G allele in hepatocytes.
CEBPA knockdown or CEBPA motif mutation reduces the T-allele enhancer activity and SORT1 expression effect.
Editing rs12740374 alone changes SORT1 expression in a CEBPA-dependent manner.
falsified_if: Allele-specific CEBPA occupancy is not stronger on the T allele at rs12740374 in a hepatocyte line.
CEBPA knockdown or motif mutation does not reduce the T-allele enhancer/SORT1 effect.
CRISPR editing of rs12740374 alone does not change SORT1 expression in hepatocytes.
